item.text: [{"task_id":"7837ac64","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    step = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    if bg not in np.unique(grid) or step <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    counts = np.bincount(grid.flatten())","    counts[bg] = 0","    lattice = int(np.argmax(counts))","    marks = np.argwhere((grid != bg) & (grid != lattice))","    if len(marks) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    low = np.min(marks, axis=0)","    high = np.max(marks, axis=0)","    rows = [r for r in range(grid.shape[0]) if low[0] <= r <= high[0] and np.all(grid[r, :] != bg)]","    cols = [c for c in range(grid.shape[1]) if low[1] <= c <= high[1] and np.all(grid[:, c] != bg)]","    if len(rows) <= step or len(cols) <= step:","        return grid.copy()","    out = np.full((len(rows) - step, len(cols) - step), bg, dtype=int)","    for r in range(out.shape[0]):","        for c in range(out.shape[1]):","            color = int(grid[rows[r], cols[c]])","            if color != bg and color != lattice:","                if grid[rows[r + step], cols[c]] == color and grid[rows[r], cols[c + step]] == color and grid[rows[r + step], cols[c + step]] == color:","                    out[r, c] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[2]},"params":{"rule":[0,1]},"rationale":"Identify the lattice and crop its intersections to the bounds of the colored markers. Each adjacent four-corner cell becomes its shared marker color when all four corners match; otherwise it becomes background. The tensors encode background color and adjacency distance."}]
